name: battle-axe
description: A battle axe standing on the end of its haft: an oval ash haft with an iron butt cap, a leather grip wrap and langets under the head, and a forged head whose eye wraps the haft, with a crescent blade (optionally bearded) towards +X and either a hammer poll or a second blade at the back, riveted, with an optional top spike.

params.name: haftLength
params.description: Length of the haft in metres (0.6-0.9 one-handed, 1.2-1.7 a two-handed Dane axe).

params.name: headSize
params.description: Length of the cutting edge from horn to horn.

params.name: bladeReach
params.description: How far the blade reaches out from the eye, as a share of the edge length.

params.name: doubleBit
params.description: Two blades, one on each side (a labrys); otherwise a single blade with a hammer poll at the back.

params.name: beard
params.description: How far the lower horn hangs down (0 = a symmetric crescent, 1 = a long Viking beard).

params.name: spike
params.description: A spike on top of the head.

params.name: wrapLength
params.description: Length of the leather grip wrap near the end of the haft.
